concepts.def: Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen designed for UNDP 1990; combines life expectancy, education and GNI per capita PPP.
Corrado Gini 1912; measures income inequality from 0 (equal) to 1 (one earner); South Africa 0.63 highest among major economies.
OPHI / UNDP since 2010; tracks health, education and living standards; 1.1 billion poor in 2023.
UN 2030 Agenda adopted September 2015; 17 goals and 169 targets, replacing the Millennium Development Goals 2000-15.
Introduced UNDP HDR 2010; combines reproductive health, empowerment and labour market participation.
Geert Hofstede's six dimensions 1980-2010 including individualism-collectivism and power distance; used in cross-cultural geography.
